title: Harris Ridge Annexation Public Hearing
summary:
*   A special meeting was convened to discuss a significant expansion of Austin's city limits.
*   The primary focus was a public hearing concerning the full purpose annexation of the Harris Ridge and McAdams areas.
*   Residents provided feedback on the proposal to extend full city services, taxes, and regulations to these neighborhoods.
*   The community meeting was held at Dessau Elementary School to facilitate local participation.
